turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My home desk is buried under papers. Bills, receipts, letters from school.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Two ways to go. Scan everything and go mostly paperless, or set up a small filing box with folders?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang tight, my dad is calling me over. Don't talk until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey Ryan, how long has that chicken been out of the freezer?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Since this morning? Around eight, I think.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So it's still frozen in the middle, isn't it.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Probably. Sorry, I meant to take it out last night and completely forgot.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's fine, I'll put it in cold water for an hour. Do you mind if we eat a bit later?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Not at all, I had a big lunch. Want me to start chopping the onions in the meantime?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes please, three of them. Thin slices, not chunks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ryan, is the oven still on?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: No, I turned it off after the bread came out.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. So, the pile of bills and letters. Which system?
